text:
Aisha: Quick design callout — posted screenshots of the new Prompt Sets & Evals UI in Figma. Looking for UX feedback specifically on regression diffs and approval flow. Thoughts?
Tom: Saw it — main question: do we show diffs inline or side-by-side? Side-by-side feels easier for reviewers.
Miguel: Side-by-side + unified scorecard at top. Scorecard should show pass/fail + delta. Example: "Overall: 82 (-3)". :thinking_face: 
Jenna: Agree about scorecard. Also need clearer CTA text: 'Approve change' is too vague. Maybe 'Approve regression acceptance' or 'Accept as new baseline'.
Aisha: Good point on copy. @DesignBot any recommendations for concise microcopy? Also accessibility — contrast on green/ red badges looked low on the figma.
DesignBot: Suggest 'Accept as baseline' (primary) and 'Flag for review' (secondary). Use patterns from system: green #0BA37F, red #E05A4B but add 4px dark border for contrast. Keyboard: make Accept triggerable via Enter when modal focused.
Tom: For diffs — propose a compact unified diff (inline) for small text changes, and an optional split view toggle for long outputs. We should auto-scroll to first difference.
Miguel: Also add run metadata in the header: model name, seed, prompt set id, runtime env, and test run timestamp. That helps triage.
Jenna: Approval workflow: can we add an optional 'require 2 approvers' toggle per test-suite? Enterprise customers will want audit trails.
Aisha: Yes — rollout idea: default single-approver, enable enterprise flag for 2-approver + audit log entry with reviewer ids and comment. Comments should be required when rejecting.
Tom: Small dev note: API will return diffs as array of {span, old, new, score_delta}. UI should be able to collapse unchanged spans. I'll add sample payload in PR.
Miguel: Accessibility nit: make sure color is not the only semantic — add icons and textual labels '↑' '↓' and 'Δ -3'.
Jenna: Copy tweak — instead of 'baseline' some folks don't know that term. Maybe 'reference run' in hover help text.
Aisha: Love that. Last thing — can we have a tiny 're-run on approve' checkbox so accept triggers a new baseline run? Use default off.
Tom: Implementable. I'll sketch the modal state machine and post tomorrow.
Aisha: Thanks all — leaving this open for another 24h for any quick thoughts. :heart:
